evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Chronic complete tear.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: Chronic degenerative maceration of the posterior horn and body.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Complex tearing affecting the posterior horn, body and anterior horn
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: Large regions of full-thickness cartilage loss throughout both sides of the weightbearing aspect of the joint
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Diffuse articular cartilage irregularity and thinning with areas of full-thickness cartilage loss at both sides of the joint
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Diffuse articular cartilage thinning with areas of high-grade fissuring at the patellar median ridge. Full-thickness cartilage loss at the lateral trochlea.
